title: The pools of financial wealth we know exist and cannot yet show, and why

columns.name: why
columns.label: Why it is not here yet

rows: Company shares and government bonds, by any owner split
The figures are published by ChinaBond and the People's Bank of China, but republishing them needs permission we do not have.
Company shares and bonds, by kind of owner

Both are in the ledger only as held by residents versus foreigners. Korea's kinds of owner sit behind a Bank of Korea key we have not been given; Switzerland publishes only what its banks hold in custody.
Company shares outside the markets in the ledger

There is no free figure for the world's listed companies that does not count some twice: the World Bank series counts India twice and leaves Taiwan out. Building one from exchange figures is the open task T31.
Bank deposits, by kind of holder
The Federal Reserve publishes it in the same release we already read; the lines have not been added yet.
Corporate bonds and fund shares, by kind of owner
They sit in the sector accounts we already read for the euro area; the lines have not been added yet. Japan's and the United Kingdom's were added on 21 September 2026 from the files already in use.
Company shares, by any owner split
Hong Kong publishes only foreigners' totals, Saudi Arabia's exchange report needs written consent, and Australia publishes no non-consolidated accounts.
